base: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent production HUD inventory icon for a bright cozy 3D farming social mobile game. Reference image is STYLE AND PALETTE ONLY; replace its backpack subject with the requested subject. Match its simple chunky rounded geometry, matte painted game material, soft low-detail shading and cheerful colors. Coral orange #F58A50, turquoise #49BCD0, warm ivory #FFF4DC, minimal dark navy #25475B accents; warm yellow only where needed for currency/face. Avoid olive, khaki, mustard, dull brown, metallic gold, glossy highlights, luxury product styling, realistic textures, stitching, thin details and web app icon appearance. Front three-quarter orthographic view with mild depth. Only a few broad modeled parts. Subject must read instantly at 32-40 pixels. Center full object with 12% clear margin on every edge. Soft bright upper-left light, subtle object shading, no external cast shadow. Actual transparent background. No surrounding tile, circle, pedestal, text, labels, logo, watermark or unrelated objects.
